criteria.commensurate: Yes. The cost moves between seeds and the aggregate stays flat. Over all 16 rolls (ref plus 10/20/40 hh, 4 seeds, best of 2): start 108.1 s, end 108.3 s (+0.2%), yard released 107.5 s, both released 108.7 s. Totals are ref +1.2% and legs -2.0% to +2.5%. No roll refuses, and 40 hh seed 4 runs 16.5 s against 17.5 s at start (the previous audit's main objection, three refusals and 15 s of web before one, is gone). The released states have their own seeds near 10%: yard released, 20 hh seed 4 +10% and 40 hh seed 47 +10.5%; both released, 20 hh seed 4 +14% and ref seed 39 +9%. A +0.2% aggregate for a green correctness gate is proportionate.
criteria.necessary: Yes, as a stopgap the spec allows. All three seed crossings (ref seed 47 +12.2%, 10 hh seed 39 +14.8%, 40 hh seed 39 +20.8%) are the PRIVY_YARD_STEP_FT hold: released alone at 6870097cd they go to 3.8 s, 2.6-2.7 s and 12.6-12.7 s (start 4.0-4.2, 2.7, 12.0-12.2). The hold keeps the pool gate green on Kuwabata (no zigzag across a joint, test_no_zigzag_straddles_a_joint) and clears Inashiro's and Sawada's knots. FR-004 holds a row where the gate needs it, E3 after its found row. The wood shed hold adds no cost: with both released 40 hh total is 54.3-54.4 s against 55.5 s with the shed held, and the three refusals come only with the yard held alone. This is not functionality the feature asks for. It lasts until gap_ways.py::_way_for#a household whose only ways zigzag re-seated lands.
criteria.no_way_around: No cheaper state keeps the gate green until the re-seat row lands. Releasing the hold reopens Kuwabata's zigzag and saves 0.7% in aggregate. Profile of 40 hh seed 39's web (cProfile 15.1 s held, 10.3 s released): the field-way search (reach.settle_field) judges 245 candidate runs held against 124 released. Each goes through settle._crossing_fault, then bridges.crossing_deck, then _lands_dry, and the joint and knot passes also run more. That is a layout effect, not a new scan. One per-candidate rescan of unchanging geometry exists: _lands_dry recomputes every flooded ring's bounding box on every deck. Hoisting it (reviewer monkeypatch) takes web from 5.23 s to 4.87-4.90 s with the lanes byte-identical. Worth landing, but it leaves the crossing (3.0 s at start).
